evidence.summary: Workspace events expose monotonic cursors, reset_required, compact identities, and explicit limitations.

reproduction.instructions: Start the resident host, consume a cursor, restart it, and assert that clients receive reset/reconciliation rather than current PASS from absent history.

summary: The landed event hub is compact and generation-bound, but it remains a bounded in-memory cursor; host restart or history age-out requires explicit status reconciliation.

workaround.description: Use status reconciliation when the bounded cursor reports reset_required; durable Forge/Store evidence remains separate from transient edit events.
